title: 37142 跟进：「问 AI」新对话未发送时切到历史对话，会把记录焦点带到那个旧对话上
body:
area:cloud · #37142 thread · session_01JQwxbZNHwt6dj15KeoAPMP

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic #36996). This is finding N4 of the contract review on PR #37215 (record 7160086862), filed by the #37142 thread as the seat's ACCEPT (comment 7160106004) asks. It is the same open nit #36999 left for its entry points.
Grading: area:cloud · Bug · p2 · evidence: read (code path below; no failing test yet).

## 维护者速读
- 问题：点「问 AI」会开一个新对话并盯住这条记录。如果用户还没发消息，就转去历史里点开另一个旧对话，这个旧对话原来盯住的记录会被这条记录覆盖。
- 影响：旧对话之后每一轮都带错记录。助手面板上的记录标签看得见，也可以手动移除，所以不会悄悄出错，但容易让人困惑。
- 要你做的：无。

## What
In `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/chatFocus.ts` (`useConversationFocus`), a `setChatFocus` hand-off that lands while the host has no conversation id sets `carry: true`. The next id that arrives then takes that focus, whatever the id is. The derived-state branch reads `carried = state.key === undefined && conversationId !== undefined && (state.carry || sendingRef.current) && state.entry.focus !== null`.

The carry exists so a pin made before the drawer resolves its thread lands on the resolved thread ("pin, then open the drawer"). It cannot tell that resolve apart from a history row the user picks. So:
1. The user clicks an `ask_ai` action. `useAskAiHandler` opens a fresh thread and pins the record with `{ follow: true }`. The fresh thread has no id, so the focus is held with carry.
2. Before sending, the user opens conversation X from the history list.
3. X's id arrives while carry is still set. X takes the record, and its stored focus (`ai-chat-focus:X`) is overwritten.

PR #37215 widened the window: every `ask_ai` click now lands on an unsent fresh thread.

## Fix direction (for the implementer to confirm)
- Carry only onto the id the host resolves for the SAME target. Drop the carry when the dock's target names a different conversation (a history pick sets `target.conversationId`).
- Or have the host spend the carry when the scope or target changes, not only on the chip's own moves.

## Acceptance
- A test in `layout/__tests__/chatFocus-36999.test.tsx` covers the sequence: `ask_ai` (or `setChatFocus` on an unsent thread), then `page.open({ agent, conversationId: 'conv-old' })`, then conv-old shows and sends its own stored focus.
- The existing "pin, then open the drawer" and first-send carry cases stay green.

Parent: #36996. Related: #37142, #37215, #36999.
